hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-none text-black
hierarchy.h2: text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-none text-black

guidelines: Headings MUST use tight letter spacing: tracking-tight or tracking-tighter.
Overlines / Labels MUST be Uppercase + Tiny + Wide Spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
Body and Data numbers use monospaced font for vertical alignment.
No Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, Lato, or Syne.
Color is Function Only. 95% of the UI should be monochrome.
Use Signal Red (#FF3B30) for removed tokens or destructive actions.
Use International Klein Blue (#002FA7) for primary CTAs and kept tokens.
Use pure Jet Black (#0A0A0A) for strong brutalist borders and text.
Use #FFFFFF for background to ensure stark contrast.

grids.marketing: Asymmetric bento grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8.
grids.dashboard: Strict grid hierarchy, dense and compact spacing. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4.

components.cards: Brutalist. Flat background, 1px or 2px solid black border, hard black shadow (shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#0A0A0A]). No blur.
components.buttons: Square or very slightly rounded (rounded-sm). High contrast background (Black or Blue), white text. Hard shadow on hover.

guidelines: Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (p-6 or p-8).
Generous Spacing Philosophy for marketing pages.
Grid Layouts MUST only have direct children.
Override default stretch behavior on grid with align-items: start where necessary.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Buttons and cards translate-y-[-2px] with increased shadow offset. ALWAYS explicitly set text color on hover.
motion_and_interactions.focus_states: High contrast ring. focus:ring-2 focus:ring-black focus:ring-offset-2.
guidelines: Animations are minimal, focused on micro-interactions for feedback.
Loading states use stark, monospaced ASCII or progress bar animations.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (The Technical Look) - Expose the skeleton. Container: border-collapse style layout. Items: border-r border-b border-black. Retro-Futurism touches for the code/terminal feel.
visual_enhancers.icons: Phosphor Icons (dense dashboards, technical feel) or Lucide-react.
guidelines: Data visualization (Recharts) should use high-contrast solid colors (Blue vs Red) with no gradients or soft shadows.
Header must have a solid background (bg-white) with a 1px solid black bottom border.

accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for normal text. Minimum 3:1 for large text.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

image_urls.description: Abstract data nodes, used as a subtle background or graphic in the hero section to represent token processing.
MacBook showing code, useful for the landing page feature section.
OpenAI logo representation, used in the 'Supported By' or 'Integrates With' section.

media_guidelines: Images should be used minimally. When used, treat them with a high-contrast black/white filter or overlay to fit the brutalist theme.
Hero Image Overlay (CRITICAL): Max overlay opacity: bg-black/50, or use a gradient overlay.
instructions_to_main_agent: Use Chivo for headings and IBM Plex Mono for body/data.
Enforce Swiss High-Contrast Brutalist style: Stark white backgrounds, solid black borders, hard drop shadows (shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#0A0A0A]).
Landing Page: Build a high-impact hero explaining token deduplication with an asymmetric bento grid layout. Use the developer context image and data node image.
Dashboard: Create a dense, F-pattern layout. Top left KPI. Use Recharts for token savings visualization (Blue for saved, Red for removed).
Admin Panel & API Keys: Clean, table-heavy interfaces using Shadcn. Strip away soft styling to match the brutalist aesthetic.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Install and use Phosphor icons: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react
Use only .js extension for files, avoiding TypeScript strictly.
